description:
The leader of Seimeikai dons a swimsuit and arrives at Coral Island for the magazine photoshoot.
This summer, she will stop at nothing to attain all that she desires.

lines.text: You don't think this is too revealing, do you?

The hot summer weather, the beach, even the swimsuits.
These are all unfamiliar to me, so I would appreciate your guidance.
I believe this attire complements the ambiance quite well.
Would you care to come inside? The sun is rather scorching out there.
I believe I have informed you before, but I do not have the habit of sharing what is mine. Since you have entered my heart, everything of yours now belongs to me.
When I close my eyes, memories of us together come flooding back... What was your favorite part of this summer?
After all the trouble I've gone through to prepare this outfit, you won't even spare me a glance? How disheartening...
I wonder where all those connections we made at the beach will lead to next? Hehe, it's quite exciting.
Have you seen Moran? After she looked at the photos we took at the beach, she started sulking, and I haven't seen her since.
When will we get to spend some time alone?
You mentioned there was a pool here, did you not? Hmm... Perhaps having it to ourselves for a day wouldn't be too egregious, would it?
I've prepared an outfit perfect for welcoming the summer. I hope it pleases you.
Memories of the sea strengthen me.
Slow but steady wins the race.
In order to have you all to myself, I must work even harder.
I hope your affections are directed solely at me, hehe.
Every time summer rolls around, I think of you.
You truly understand me.
Our connection has deepened by leaps and bounds this summer. Even the taste of tea will grow richer for me.
Your presence always makes me feel at ease.
Please don't ever change. Let me come to you.
I knew you would choose me.
Did you call?
What a lovely breeze.
This time, I'll be the one supporting you.
What your heart desires, I shall make it a reality.
I will fulfill my duties.
I will show you the way of the Seimeikai.
Don't rush it.
The heat is rising.
I entrust this to you momentarily.
Awaiting your orders.
May this radiant summer day remain beautiful.
You've touched what is mine. You will pay the price.
That was nothing.
Let's keep it going.
... Finished.
Ow!
Careless.
*Cough*
Was it all just memories of a midsummer night...?
It seems I will now be able to enjoy some quiet time with you.
